// This fixture is copied by CI into the independently checked-out native
// Identity Vault source tree at its pinned revision. It is compiled in the
// actual Vault package; pqKeys.proof is NOT reimplemented in this test.
package main

import(
 "crypto/ed25519"
 "crypto/rand"
 "io"
 "encoding/base64"
 "encoding/json"
 "strings"
 "testing"
 "time"
 "github.com/XDSawyerLoL/QuanticMail/quantic-control/vaultsession"
)
func TestSentinelVerifiesActualNativeVaultProof(t *testing.T){
 kem,err:=pqGenerate("ML-KEM-768")
 if err!=nil{t.Fatal(err)}
 defer kem.close()
 dsa,err:=pqGenerate("ML-DSA-65")
 if err!=nil{t.Fatal(err)}
 defer dsa.close()
 p,err:=pqMake(kem,dsa,"sentinel~"+strings.Repeat("a",32)+"@quantic","d-"+strings.Repeat("b",32))
 if err!=nil{t.Fatal(err)}
 id:=vaultsession.Identity{Address:p.address,Device:p.device,KEMPin:p.kemPin,DSAPin:p.dsaPin,DSAPublicDER:p.dsaPub}
 now:=time.Now()
 s,err:=vaultsession.New(id,"native-vault-integration-test",now)
 if err!=nil{t.Fatal(err)}
 // This is the exact method called by the native broker's pq-proof-lab op.
 sig,err:=p.proof(s.Request().PQChallenge)
 if err!=nil{t.Fatal(err)}
 raw,err:=json.Marshal(vaultsession.Reply{OK:true,PQProof:base64.RawURLEncoding.EncodeToString(sig)})
 if err!=nil{t.Fatal(err)}
 if err:=s.Verify(raw,time.Now());err!=nil{t.Fatal(err)}
 if s.Verify(raw,time.Now())==nil{t.Fatal("replay accepted")}
 another,err:=vaultsession.New(id,"different-machine",time.Now())
 if err!=nil{t.Fatal(err)}
 if another.Verify(raw,time.Now())==nil{t.Fatal("proof for different challenge accepted")}
}


// Real broker framing, approval callback, journal and ML-DSA provider;
// ONLY the independent checkpoint authority and UI approval are test doubles.
// No user identity, production credentials or privileged OS operation.
func TestSentinelAuthenticatedNativeBroker(t *testing.T){
 for _,mode:=range []string{"approved","denied","wrong-controller","anchor-unavailable"}{
  t.Run(mode,func(t *testing.T){
   controllerPub,controllerKey,err:=ed25519.GenerateKey(rand.Reader)
   if err!=nil{t.Fatal(err)}
   defer clear(controllerKey)
   brokerPub:=controllerPub
   if mode=="wrong-controller"{
    brokerPub,_,err=ed25519.GenerateKey(rand.Reader)
    if err!=nil{t.Fatal(err)}
   }
   keys,err:=freshPortable();if err!=nil{t.Fatal(err)}
   kem,err:=pqGenerate("ML-KEM-768");if err!=nil{t.Fatal(err)};defer kem.close()
   dsa,err:=pqGenerate("ML-DSA-65");if err!=nil{t.Fatal(err)};defer dsa.close()
   pq,err:=pqMake(kem,dsa,"sentinel~"+strings.Repeat("a",32)+"@quantic","d-"+strings.Repeat("b",32))
   if err!=nil{t.Fatal(err)}
   path,a,b,c:=testJournal(t)
   journal,err:=openReplay(path,a,b,c);if err!=nil{t.Fatal(err)};defer journal.close()
   witness:=&fakeAnchor{tail:journal.tail}
   aid,err:=anchorID(a,b,c);if err!=nil{t.Fatal(err)}
   if err=journal.attachAnchor(witness,aid);err!=nil{t.Fatal(err)}
   if mode=="anchor-unavailable"{witness.fail=true}
   s,err:=vaultsession.New(vaultsession.Identity{Address:pq.address,Device:pq.device,KEMPin:pq.kemPin,DSAPin:pq.dsaPin,DSAPublicDER:pq.dsaPub},"broker-test",time.Now())
   if err!=nil{t.Fatal(err)}
   toVaultR,toVaultW:=io.Pipe()
   fromVaultR,fromVaultW:=io.Pipe()
   defer toVaultR.Close();defer toVaultW.Close();defer fromVaultR.Close();defer fromVaultW.Close()
   done:=make(chan error,1)
   approvals:=0
   go func(){
    err:=authenticateFrames(brokerPub,toVaultR,fromVaultW,func(in io.Reader,out io.Writer)error{
     return serveGuardedPQ(softwareSigner{keys.signing},keys.agreement,"synthetic-test",in,out,func(detail string)bool{
      approvals++
      return mode!="denied"
     },journal,pq,&senderTrust{contacts:map[string]senderContact{}})
    })
    fromVaultW.Close()
    done<-err
   }()
   result:=vaultsession.ExchangeBrokerProof(fromVaultR,toVaultW,s,controllerKey,controllerPub)
   toVaultW.Close()
   fromVaultR.Close()
   select{
   case err=<-done:
   case <-time.After(5*time.Second):t.Fatal("broker did not finish")
   }
   if mode=="approved"{
    if result!=nil||err!=nil||approvals!=1||witness.count!=1||len(journal.seen)!=1{
     t.Fatalf("approved proof failed: %v broker=%v approvals=%d journal=%d witness=%d",result,err,approvals,len(journal.seen),witness.count)
    }
   }else{
    if result==nil{t.Fatalf("%s unexpectedly authenticated",mode)}
    if witness.count!=0||len(journal.seen)!=0{t.Fatal("refused proof committed")}
    if mode=="wrong-controller"&&approvals!=0{t.Fatal("wrong controller reached approval")}
    if mode=="denied"&&approvals!=1{t.Fatal("approval refusal not exercised")}
    if mode=="anchor-unavailable"&&(!journal.failed||approvals!=1){t.Fatal("anchor refusal not exercised")}
   }
  })
 }
}
